digest.component_or_area: code_health size metrics readers / metrics registry
propositions: Migrate code_health size metrics off the hardcoded src/rebar scan and module-size-limit.txt onto the scc LOC analyzer and [code_health] config.
Add an analyzer adapter (_analyzer_spec) whose compute calls scc_loc.analyze(repo_root, scan_roots) and returns Unavailable rather than fabricated zeros for non-Python/foreign repos.
Rework size fns to a uniform 3-arg signature (loc, size_cap, size_near_fraction) computing count, over_cap_count, near_cap_count (inclusive band), and max_loc, returning None when size_cap is None.
Extend _commands/metrics.py ctx to carry scan_roots, size_cap, and size_near_fraction from the [code_health] config.
Remove legacy hardcodes (_LIMIT_FILE, _read_cap, src/rebar rglob), deregister cap_change_events, and drop the oversized_module_count seed stub so one structural spec remains.
Analyzer-derived specs carry source=structural and lens=code_health provenance while module_size_trend stays a stub returning Unavailable.
